name: Kohler C2 Outdoor Sauna Kit
description: Kohler C2 Outdoor Sauna Kit, Up to 6-People The Kohler C2 Outdoor Sauna features a premium Scandinavian spruce wood interior and Weathered Grey Spruce or Douglas Fir exterior that provides an attractive appearance. An obeche wood bench and matching backrest with 2700k warm white indirect lighting positioned behind it provide a comfortable sauna experience. The tempered glass door and windows, along with mineral wool insulation and rubber seals, provide excellent heat retention. The C2 Outdoor Sauna includes a freestanding FERO Sauna Heater, along with Sauna Stones and Heater Guard. A digital control panel mounted externally provides easy access to sauna temperature, session time, and backrest lighting. It features a cover that securely locks to protect it from the elements or unauthorized use. The C2 Outdoor Sauna is also designed for freestanding installation, providing flexibility for your sauna’s location. Installation is available. Assembly only, electrical not included.
